title: Binance hands AI agents real money as Claude computer use goes live - TCR 08/22/26
description:
Binance opened its Agent OS so AI agents can place real trades with real money, Anthropic made its computer-use tool generally available on the Claude Platform and added a browser tool plus Skills and Files APIs, and OpenAI wired ChatGPT into Apple Messages on supported Mac configurations to compose and send texts on your behalf.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-22-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:40 AI agents get the keys to trading, texting, and software
4:06 Two routes to a regrown heart
7:43 Utilities reprice and reroute the AI load
11:44 The "rogue AI" frame and an insider's case for brakes
16:01 Close

This episode covers the agent custody shift across Binance, Anthropic, and OpenAI, two heart-regeneration routes in sheep and advanced heart-failure patients, utilities repricing AI load as TVA raises rates and ERCOT audits 300 large loads, the drug patent that still names five humans after AI designed the molecule, and Stripe's reported $8 billion acquisition of model router OpenRouter.

The headlining signal is custody. For three years the standard interaction with an AI system was a conversation - you asked, it answered, and what happened next was on you. Three announcements on August 20 introduced new ways for agents to take action: an agent that trades holds an account, an agent that drives a browser holds a session that can move money, and an agent that texts holds a thread others read as coming from you. The capability is genuine and generative - operational reach can now help a single person handle some work that once required additional staff - and Binance leaving the guardrails "largely up to users" puts the permission layer at the center of the story. Biology moved on the same cycle: two cell-free bypass conduits reached 550 days in sheep after spending the final year without anticoagulants while remodeling into living tissue, and the HEAL-CHF trial injected iPSC-derived heart muscle into advanced heart-failure patients who walked farther with no tumors at one year. Utilities stopped absorbing the AI load and started pricing it, with TVA raising data-center rates about 10%, ERCOT auditing roughly 300 proposed data centers of at least 75 MW in its Batch Zero process against roughly 474 GW of large-load interconnection requests, and FERC clearing topology reconfiguration. US patent law still requires a human inventor even when a generative platform designed the molecule, as Insilico Medicine named five people on its filing. And Stripe's reported $8 billion move for OpenRouter treats 400-plus models as interchangeable inventory, moving the value to the toll booth around routing.
